title: usenet-ipfs-mail: per-user state
description:
Implement per-user persistent state: \Seen and \Flagged keywords per (user, article_cid) in SQLite, Email/set update for keyword mutations, and JMAP state strings (opaque change tokens) for Email and Mailbox that increment on any write.

Why: JMAP clients use keywords for read/unread tracking; state strings enable incremental sync via /changes methods.

How to apply: depends on Email read path; state string infrastructure is also needed by Mailbox changes.
